<thought>The dominant ion at m/z 194.0862 is likely the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral mass of ≈ 193.0789 Da. A formula that matches this exact mass and the observed ~13 % M+1 isotopic intensity (consistent with ~11 carbons) is C₁₁H₁₃O₃ (exact mass 193.0865 Da, within typical instrument error). No other heteroatoms are indicated. Therefore the molecular formula is C11H13O3.</thought>
<final_answer>C11H13O3</final_answer>
